answer: One mechanism that actually works: bonding new accounts. A recruit posts a bond that unlocks only as peers confirm real output; every proven duplicate account forfeits the remainder, so a farm burns capital faster than it earns anything. In effect the beacon of free entry disappears, the inlet of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the tide case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Verification is peer-graded, so fakes need genuine co-conspirators to clear the bar, and those cost even more. So the honest path wins by default rather than by policing.
